description: Fort Wayne Pride is the largest area celebration of the LGBTQ community and includes live entertainment, a vendor market, nonprofit resource fair, food, a beer tent, trivia, KidSpace and Pride March. All supporters are welcome to join us for one of the best parties of the year!
